one_line: Regent-queen of the Chaulukya (Solanki) kingdom who led Gujarat’s resistance around the Battle of Kasahrada in 1178 CE.

appearance.age_look: She appears in her early 30s, with a medium, athletic build and poised warrior-queen bearing.
appearance.face: Oval face with sharp, straight nose, medium-full lips, and expressive large almond-shaped dark brown eyes; wheatish-light brown complexion with a subtle sun-kissed tan; a small bindi and a light vertical worry line between her brows; default expression is calm, focused determination with a hint of sternness.
appearance.hair: Thick, long black hair parted slightly off-center, drawn back into a single, heavy braid that reaches mid-back; the braid is wrapped at the base with a narrow red cloth band and finished at the end with a small gold-cap ornament; she wears a simple, rounded gold circlet-style band (thin, no high crown) resting just above the forehead, with a tiny central teardrop motif.
appearance.costume: She wears a late-12th-century western Indian royal-war attire: an inner, ankle-length cotton angarkha-style tunic in muted off-white with a slight flare at the hem; over it a fitted, sleeved quilted war-jerkin (padded coat) that reaches mid-thigh, dyed deep indigo-blue with subtle vertical stitch lines and a wrap-style closure tied on the right with cloth ties; beneath, she has narrow churidar-style trousers in matte maroon that gather neatly at the ankles; over her torso she has a mail-and-plate style hauberk suggested as overlapping small dull-steel scales sewn over the indigo padding, stopping just above the knee, with side slits for movement; a broad, soft cotton patka (sash) in rich saffron-orange wraps around her waist twice and knots on the left hip, the ends hanging to mid-thigh with a woven geometric border in dark red and white; she wears a light but broad dupatta/odhni in pale cream with a fine red border draped from her left shoulder across the back and tucked at the right waist, giving her a royal silhouette but kept clear of her sword arm; jewellery is restrained but regal and practical: small round gold stud earrings, a short, flat gold necklace close to the neck, slim gold bangles on each wrist (three per wrist, not overly jangling) and a plain gold finger ring on her right hand; her footwear is sturdy brown leather mojari-style shoes with slightly upturned toes and simple stitched patterns, scuffed from travel.
appearance.signature: A single-handed broad-tipped Indian sword (early talwar-like) with a gently curving, broad steel blade, a simple cross-guard hilt wrapped in dark brown leather, and a rounded disc pommel; the scabbard is dark brown leather with a narrow brass chape and hangs from a brown leather baldric worn diagonally over her right shoulder.

ref_desc: Naikidevi is a wheatish-complexioned, early-30s warrior-queen with a long braided black ponytail, thin gold circlet, indigo quilted war-coat over off-white tunic and maroon trousers, saffron sash, pale cream dupatta and a curved steel sword in brown scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Naikidevi, a 12th-century Chaulukya regent-queen: she is in her early 30s with a medium athletic build, wheatish-light brown complexion, an oval face, sharp straight nose, medium-full lips, and large almond-shaped dark brown eyes set in a calm but stern expression with a small bindi; her thick black hair is parted slightly off-center and tied into a single long braid to mid-back, wrapped at the base with a red cloth band and finished with a small gold-cap ornament, and she wears a thin rounded gold circlet resting just above her forehead with a tiny central teardrop motif; dress her in historically grounded late-12th-century western Indian royal-war attire: an ankle-length off-white cotton angarkha-style tunic, over which sits a fitted, sleeved, mid-thigh quilted war-jerkin dyed deep indigo-blue with visible vertical stitching and a wrap closure tied on the right, covered on the torso by overlapping dull-steel scale-like armor panels; she wears narrow maroon churidar-style trousers gathered at the ankles and sturdy brown leather mojari shoes with slightly upturned toes; around her waist wrap a broad saffron-orange cotton sash twice, knotted at the left hip with its ends hanging, bordered by subtle dark red and white geometric patterns, and drape a pale cream dupatta with a fine red edge from her left shoulder across her back and tucking it at the right waist, arranged to keep her sword arm free; add restrained royal jewellery—small round gold stud earrings, a short flat gold necklace, three slim gold bangles on each wrist, and a plain gold ring on her right hand; her signature weapon is a gently curving single-handed broad-tipped Indian sword with a plain cross-guard, dark brown leather-wrapped hilt, rounded disc pommel and a dark brown leather scabbard with brass tip hanging from a brown leather baldric across her chest; ensure the dominant colors are indigo blue, saffron orange, maroon, off-white and steel grey, and show her from front, three-quarter and back views to clearly display face, hair, full costume and sword consistently.
